title: Impact of Serum Progesterone Levels on the Day of β-hCG Test in Artificial Cycles on the Ongoing Pregnancy Rate.
official: Impact of Serum Progesterone Levels on the Day of β-hCG Test in Artificial Cycles on the Ongoing Pregnancy Rate.
summary: Prospective cohort multicentric study including infertile patients undergoing a pregnancy test on βhCG day (around ET +11), after an ET in the context of an artificial cycle and receiving LPS with vaginal natural progesterone following the clinical practice in IVI RMA (Spain).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The subject must provide written informed consent prior to any study related procedures
* Women ≤50 years old
* BMI ≤ 35 kg/m2
* Adequate endometrial thickness (\>6.5mm) and pattern (Triple A structure) in the proliferative phase

Exclusion Criteria:

* Uterine Pathology, adnexal pathology
* Systemic diseases
sponsor: Instituto Valenciano de Infertilidad, IVI VALENCIA
